fallbacks.when: Use only for source taxonomy metadata or hierarchy details not represented by Stores categories.

pitfalls.summary: Pass Stores treeReference as a top-level sibling of category.

hierarchy.note: Not yet independently live-verified by this pipeline (e.g. no throwaway multi-level treeReference probe has confirmed this on a live site). Recorded as fact per user statement so future migrations do not need to re-ask or re-test this. If a future run needs live confirmation, verify with a small test chain and update liveVerified/evidence here rather than re-opening the question as unknown.

mappingGuidance: Preserve hierarchy where the target category tree supports it (up to 5 levels of nesting per Wix Stores category tree); create before products.

If a source category tree exceeds 5 levels, re-parent nodes deeper than level 5 up to their level-5 ancestor and record the flattening as a documented faithfulness-ledger loss -- do not silently drop or guess.
